mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crew_tb (crew_id, user_id, crew_name, crew_detail, crew_img_url, crew_region, crew_status, max_members, create_dt, update_dt) VALUES (0, #{userId}, #{crewName}, #{crewDetail}, #{crewImgUrl}, #{crewRegion}, "ACTIVE", #{maxMembers}, now(), null);
mapper.select: SELECT ct.*, COUNT(cu.user_id) AS currentMembers FROM crew_tb AS ct LEFT JOIN crew_user_tb cu ON ct.crew_id = cu.crew_id WHERE ct.crew_id = #{crewId};

SELECT ct.*, COALESCE(SUM(lt.like_count), 0) AS totalLikes, COUNT(cu.user_id) AS currentMembers FROM crew_tb AS ct LEFT JOIN crew_user_tb cu ON ct.crew_id = cu.crew_id LEFT JOIN user_tb ut ON cu.user_id = ut.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM like_tb WHERE create_dt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY user_id ) AS lt ON(ut.user_id = lt.user_id) GROUP BY ct.crew_id, ct.crew_name ORDER BY totalLikes DESC, currentMembers DESC LIMIT 5;
